summary.en: A globally normalized model offers an alternative approach to de novo peptide sequencing.
summary.zh: 全局归一化模型为肽从头测序提供新路线。

en: Today's brief examines NovoCRF, a preprint combining a prefix-mass lattice with global sequence scoring for de novo peptide sequencing. Its amino-acid recall gains are promising, while peptide-level gains and broader generalization still require independent validation.
Coverage is limited to accessible evidence; this selection does not establish the absence of advances in other computational mass spectrometry areas.
zh: 今日关注NovoCRF预印本：以前缀质量格点与全局序列评分结合，探索肽从头测序的新路线。氨基酸召回的提升值得关注，肽层面的收益与更广泛泛化仍需独立验证。
覆盖限于可获取的证据，本次精选不代表质谱计算方法其他方向没有进展。

papers.title: NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice

read_scope.en: Abstract and full-text methods, results and discussion; not reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 摘要及全文方法、结果与讨论；未复现。

commentary.zh: 以物理离子特征和前缀质量格点构建全局归一化CRF，结合精确候选解码与双阶段重排，为肽从头测序提供新路线。七个留出DDA数据集平均氨基酸召回64.0%，Casanovo v5为53.1%；肽召回42.4%对39.1%差异未达统计显著。每集仅一个原始文件、依赖准确前体质量，速度比较配置不同，需独立验证。
commentary.en: NovoCRF combines ion features and a prefix-mass lattice in a globally normalized CRF, followed by exact candidate decoding and reranking. Across seven held-out DDA datasets, mean amino-acid recall was 64.0% versus 53.1% for Casanovo v5, while peptide recall of 42.4% versus 39.1% was not statistically significant. Each dataset contained one raw file, accuracy depends on precursor mass, and timing used different hardware; independent validation is needed.
